evidence.claim: Telegram Expert pricing model is subscription-based with duration-dependent pricing
evidence.value: Single plan with price depending on subscription period (1 month, 1 year, 2 years, 3 years). Entry point ~$120/mo standalone. 3-year plan ~$1,350 total (~$37.50/mo). 24h free trial available.
evidence.source_title: AFFDAYS - Top 3 Telegram Bulk Account Creators
evidence.quote: There is only one plan, but the price depends on the subscription period. A trial is also available.

evidence.claim: Telegram Expert offers modular add-ons: Converter, Booster, Registrar, Duplicator, Forwarder, Interceptor, Channel Cloner, Reporter, etc.
evidence.value: Base software includes auto-registration, message broadcast, audience parser, inviter, boosting, account management panel, auto-responder, reporter. Premium modules sold separately: Converter ($990), Booster ($990), Registrar ($1,250). Additional modules: Universal Registrar, Duplicator, Chat/Channel Cloner, Forwarder, Invite via Admin, Message Interceptor.
evidence.quote: Premium modules (Booster $990, Registrar $1,250) sold separately for specialised workflows.
